user.title: Set up heating control
user.description: Basic settings. Add rooms afterwards via 'Configure'. The controller starts in observation mode and changes nothing until you enable 'Eingriffe aktiv'.

data_description.boiler_climate: Climate entity of the boiler. Its room sensor (current_temperature) is the base value; its setpoint is controlled.
data_description.outdoor_sensor: Needed for the learning room model (heat loss).
data_description.persons: When all of them are away, the controller switches to away. Leave empty to disable presence logic.
data_description.label_alltag: Scheduler schedules with this label run in everyday mode.
data_description.label_urlaub: Scheduler schedules with this label run in 'holiday at home'.
data_description.abwesend_plan: Optional. Runs in 'holiday away'; otherwise the holiday-away temperature is used.
data_description.notify_services: E.g. notify.mobile_app_iphone. Used for window reminders.

abort.already_configured: Heating control is already set up.

data_description.outdoor_sensor: Needed for the learning room model (heat loss).
data_description.persons: When all of them are away, the controller switches to away. Leave empty to disable presence logic.
data_description.label_alltag: Scheduler schedules with this label run in everyday mode.
data_description.label_urlaub: Scheduler schedules with this label run in 'holiday at home'.
data_description.abwesend_plan: Optional. Runs in 'holiday away'; otherwise the holiday-away temperature is used.
data_description.notify_services: E.g. notify.mobile_app_iphone. Used for window reminders.

data_description.thermostat_type: Manual: the integration creates a 'Thermostat-Stufe' select; the room is not controlled and does not count towards demand.
data_description.climate: Smart thermostat only, e.g. the Better Thermostat entity.
data_description.valve_sensors: Optional, one or more sensors in %. Improves the room model.
data_description.temperature_sensor: Optional. Otherwise the thermostat's current temperature.
data_description.window_sensor: Optional. Open window: room does not count towards demand.
data_description.in_demand: Off: room never calls for the boiler (e.g. hallway).
data_description.heimkehr_boost: On homecoming raise at least to the homecoming temperature.
data_description.max_temperature: Optional. Higher setpoints are capped to this value.

ausnahme.name: Exception while away
ausnahme.description: E.g. children's room: warm in the afternoon even if the parents are away.

rhythmus.name: Recurring absence
rhythmus.description: E.g. every other weekend at the other parent's. Switch and dates appear as entities.

data_description.humidity_sensor: Optional. Remind only once humidity is below the limit.
